statement: No rank-six matrix G in F_3^(6 x 11) has the four-all-symbol PIR property: for every such G, at least one column fails to have four pairwise-disjoint recovery sets. Consequently ASP(6,4,3)=12, using the frozen source bound 11 <= ASP(6,4,3) <= 12.
contribution: A complete symmetry reduction to normalized systematic matrices, an exact one-hot finite-field SAT encoding, and an independently replayed DRUP refutation close the frozen source's one-unit ternary gap. The bounded literature search found no equivalent later primary resolution, but this submission makes no unconditional priority claim.
